items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: Yeah. But that was an album on a show we were working on called “Big Man” which was like about John Henry.

ctx.x: That one record you did, “Black Messiah” I think it was, there was some interesting stuff on that too. Music from that, didn’t they write a Broadway show? Called John Henry or something?

Yeah. But that was an album on a show we were working on called “Big Man” which was like about John Henry. And Cannon and Nat had written all the music for that. We recorded it actually. But before we could get the show off the ground, he passed away. Yeah, it was beautiful.
What’s the road like for your aspiring musicians, being on the road? Good and bad?
